verdict_reason: Monthly Custom Satellite Embeddings are real but gated behind a competitive academic application, deadline 2026-10-15, India coverage unconfirmed. PMFBY has no public event-dated dataset; only aggregate claims-paid figures found, portal unreachable, so ground truth must be constructed.

sources.coverage_quote: Global terrestrial land surfaces and shallow waters, including intertidal zones, inland waterways, and coastal areas
caveats_quoted: This is the ANNUAL product; it cannot resolve within-year sowing-failure/flood/recovery timing, which is the candidate's stated reason for needing monthly embeddings instead

ground_truth.construction_protocol: Cross-reference PMFBY district claims-paid records, state disaster-management flood situation reports, and IMD rainfall extremes to date flood/sowing-failure windows per district-season; manually label roughly 20-40 district-season events.

compute_path.platform: Google Earth Engine (embeddings consumed as precomputed EE image assets/COGs; downstream classifier on free tier or Colab)
compute_path.why: Assuming embeddings are obtained, they are precomputed 64-band vectors; downstream classification/regression is lightweight, no sustained local GPU training required.
